==Notes==
* This skill exactly requires 80 units of adrenaline to be fully charged, so 3 strikes and 5 units.
* This skill has the third highest damage increase of any Warrior [[attack skill]], surpassed only by [[Decapitate]] and by [[Final Thrust]] used against a target below 50% health.
